notes.title: HotFix 1.0.2
notes.content:
We're pushing a quick Hotfix! Thanks to Sosich for catching the Relic bug! 

[b]Fixes: [/b]

[list]
[*] Improved achievement tracking to minimize bugs/errors. (If you've earned achievements and haven't gotten them to pop, this update should fix that for you.)
[*] Added a missing relic to Everfin levels. (It was previously supposed to be in Level 4, but our Objective Tiles were punting it out of existence. We stuck it in Level 5 instead.)
[*] Fixed sound issues with Atom Boots, Wind, and Metal Virballs. (You shouldn't get your ears blasted off anymore by the surprising sounds.)
[*] Added a shiny new skin for people who help us find bugs!
[/list]

If you find a bug in the game, please let Nicole know either through Discord or the steam discussion threads. We've got a sweet skin to gift you for your help!

If you've helped us hunt down a bug and Nicole hasn't contacted you with a code for this skin yet, please DM her.

notes.title: Virballs Merrock Launch
notes.content:
Patch 0.4.0 Early Access

[h1]Merrock Planet Launch[/h1]

Welcome back Virballers! We're almost at the finish line, but we've got one more major update for you while you wait! 

Update 0.4.0 brings you a few new cool things to play with so let's get to the patch notes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/0d343a24f07183554500d57db3d2afc2c1c89529.png[/img]

[h2]New Additions: [/h2]

[h3]Merrock Planet Release [/h3]- Unlocking the Electric Core, means that you have new Virballs combinations. 
[list]
[*] Mine
[*] Thunder
[*] Gravity
[*] Laser
[*] Lightning
[/list]

[h3]Relics! [/h3]
Jambito, Everfin, and Merrock have been populated with this new item. Find the relics and you will be able to use them to buy new skins for Orb! 

[list]
[*] Added a pop-up visual for relic collection.
[*] We've added a tutorial to show you how to find them and spend them. 
[*] We've added a shop UI that shows you the cool skins that our art team has created for Orb. 
[*] Added UI to the Skins menu which will show you how many relics you've collected. 
[/list]

[h3]Balance Pass on Atom Completion [/h3]
It was hard to collect all of the atoms before as some atoms were located in impossible to reach areas. We completed a pass and balanced that difficulty. Happy Hunting!

[h2]Bug Fixes![/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that made it difficult to grab Virballs
[*] We optimized several environmental tiles that were creating a laggy playing experience. Your game should run more smoothly now. 
[*] One of our Bosses (Not naming any names, Octoclaw...) wasn't allowing you to complete the fight, so we fixed that. You should be able to complete that level now. 
[/list]


That's all we have for now, friends. Have fun with the new content and if you find any bugs or even something you love, let us know on our [url=https://discord.gg/gsqv6fS3wS]Discord server! [/url]

notes.title: Virballs Holiday Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/5156f901f489e90cef7ece10b8b040849423e5f4.png[/img]

We have a big update for you this week, so get comfy and see what's incoming!

[h2]New Additions:[/h2]

First, happy holidays! We're so happy to have you as part of our community. All of the good Orbs get a new [b]Christmas Candy Skin![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/67b498235436be6b4c74ac25f05f8a3247fdb33b.png[/img]

You can find this in your skins menu on the pause menu. 

[h3]Next up is Dr. Corvid's Lab! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/84d9f27844ada5d86178c5d59f07ac4b5d9f526c.png[/img]

We've been teasing our challenge sandbox mode for a while now, and it's finally here!

Players can unlock this new mode through the world menu either with your mouse or gamepad. 

Players will start with 6 challenges to beat. They range in intensity and difficulty from ludicrous to plaid. Good luck, and beware, the bees! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/a58edcf831985a6bd1209bc5a7c958840bf3f58f.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Enter The Inferno! (Wave Survival Challenge, 3 Waves)
Fight fire with fire! Face off against various flame-based Virball combinations with only the Fire Virball Core at your disposal.
[*] Survival of the Squishiest (Wave Survival Challenge, 3 Waves)
 Prove that you are worthy of the Water Core by facing off against each Virball combination that has Water as a secondary element.
[*] Quarantine (Exterminate Challenge, Clear 100 in 100 seconds)
 You have 100 seconds to kill 100 Virballs, which will spawn continuously from all sides. Did your time at Janitor school prepare you for this?
[*] Plumbing Duty (Wave Survival Challenge, 4 Waves)
 Some of the pipes in the Lab are seriously blocked up with excess Virium. Each pipe will start out as a trickle, but watch out! The source of each clog is a massive Virball!
[*] Cage Match (Exterminate Challenge, Clear 20 in 60 seconds)
 Stuck in close quarters and with only a drip feed of ammo, you only have one minute left on the clock to defeat your enormous opponent.
[*] Gas Leak (Exterminate Challenge, Clear 50 in 60 seconds)
Be quick about tracking down these tricky stray Air Virballs, or you won't meet your quota!
[/list]
Have fun beating those challenges!

You'll also be able to play in the Sandbox where all cores and virballs are unlocked until full release. 

[h2]Bug Fixes: [/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed defect of Collection Badge Obtained - should be more accurate
[*] The Map View now shows the total amount of atoms you’re able to collect and the current amount you are at
[/list]

That's all for now. We'll see you next year, with some exciting new updates and the full release!

notes.title: Build 0.2.1-EA
notes.content:
[h1]Build 0.2.1-EA[/h1]

The first December update is here! We’ve added a few quality of life updates as well as some fixes. 

[h2]New Stuff: [/h2]

New Atom Update Release!  - Finally those atoms have meaning! Once you collect enough of them, you’ll be able to overcharge! This gives you damage and speed bonuses in combat. 

[list]
[*] Added a tutorial for atom overcharge and atom completion
[*] Added threshold atom completion UI to top right of screen
[*] Pressing ‘X’, will activate atom overcharge
[*] Removed atom completion score in the Achievements screen and replaced it with earning badge instead
[*] Added a “Collection Badge Obtained” popup – This lets you know that you’ve collected enough atoms to complete the level. (At least 90%)
[*] Added Capsule Boss music 
[*] Updated world map music
[/list]

[h2]QOL Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added Skins Menu to the Pause Menu for better visibility (It was previously in options menu)
[*] We gave the Air Virball a little makeover. He looks better now. 
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed defect in tubes that wasn’t showing the correct material mesh.
[/list]

notes.title: Virballs Roadmap 2.0
notes.content:
[h1]Roadmap 2.0 [/h1]

It’s been a busy few months since we launched the Early Access version of Virballs. In that time, we’ve added Orb’s rolling ability, revamped our sounds and music, added new tiles to Jambito and finally launched Everfin. 

The team is back from the holiday break, and we’re working harder than ever to bring you new content to play in the next few months and prepare the game for its full launch.
Here’s the updated roadmap.

[h2]December[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/84d9f27844ada5d86178c5d59f07ac4b5d9f526c.png[/img]

[olist]
[*] 12/10 Everfin Bug Squashing.
[*] 12/10 Atom Update: We’ve been listening, and you’re right. The atoms don’t make a lot of sense. Hopefully, we will change that with this update, making collecting atoms fun and challenging.
[*]  12/17 Dr. Corvid’s Lab:  This update brings you a new challenge sandbox mode. Complete the challenges and win fun prizes. You will also be able to play outside the challenges and face off against any Virball in the game until launch.
[*] Orb Holiday Skin 
[*] Holiday Card / Background / Phone wallpaper
[/olist]

[h2]January[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/0d343a24f07183554500d57db3d2afc2c1c89529.png[/img]
[list]
[*] 1/7 Fixing Bugs from Dr. Corvid’s Lab
[*] 1/14  Merrock World Release
[*]  1/21 Fixing any bugs that come from the Merrock release.
[/list]

[h2]February[/h2]
We’ll launch the final version of Virballs with all of the planets in February. We'll announce the date the closer we get to release. 

And don't forget! We stream every week on Twitch!  Join us on Wednesdays at 3pm Pacific / 6pm Eastern / 11pm GMT  [url=https://www.twitch.tv/Virballs]https://www.twitch.tv/Virballs[/url]

That's all for now! Remember, if it's cold where you are right now, Everfin is always nice and Sunny!

notes.title: The Everfin Release
notes.content:
[h1]Everfin [/h1]

Welcome to Everfin, a planet with beautiful oceans, tropical fauna, and ...an unfortunate infestation of Virballs. They’ve created a cacophony of chaos in a once beautiful world. The server droids have run amok, and the pools are filled with unmentionable creatures. Only Orb can save this planet now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/af7b331a29fdb79d1e07f5bec70a10b70a55442c.jpg[/img]


Beating Jambito means that you’ve unlocked the Water Core which means: New water Virballs combinations. Each of these new Virballs has a different attack. You might just find a new favorite ammo! 

•	Deep
•	Coral
•	Tiki
•	Ice
•	Snow
•	Mine
•	Eel

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/8362a93d7a45d19bff5307740ecc61b528f00409.jpg[/img]

Five new levels are ready for you to play! This means that you have all new challenges waiting to be conquered. Here’s what you can expect: 

•	To help you out, we’ve added an additional dash powerup. Jump farther than you’ve ever jumped before!
•	New rescue missions
•	New hunt/exterminate missions
•	New enemies:
•	Clams
•	Nibblefish
•	Server Droids
•	New flying capsule boss

A New Final Boss Awaits: Octoclaw. We’ve upped the stakes with this new boss, and we’ve added some new cinematics to flavor the fun. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/55447a587030b12567b4d114979c8ddc9f4dc711.jpg[/img]


[h2]Other Enhancements[/h2]

Jambito:
•	Added a new intro cinematic to hunt enemies (in level 4)
Other:
•	Updated the status effect for damage types
•	Updates to the world map menu: added atoms icon next to percentages

notes.title: Build 0.1.3-EA
notes.content:
[h1]Build 0.1.3-EA[/h1]

In this patch, we took our player’s feedback on the Tutorials, the way we communicate with you in the game, and the game’s voice over sounds and did an overhaul. You should see a marked improvement. 

[h2]Changes:[/h2]

•	Updated text prompts – We’ve overhauled some of the tutorial and other text prompts that you see in the game. 
•	Added button press UI – There are now tutorials in the game that won’t allow you to continue until you’ve pressed the appropriate buttons. 
•	Removed all of the old VO and replaced it with new sounds. Characters will now only use noises instead of full lines
•	Updated the sound quality

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]

•	Fixed bug for when using a charged weapon, spam clicking would consume 1 ammo per click, even if no projectile is spawned. It should now work as intended.

notes.title: Virballs 2024 Roadmap
notes.content:
Hi there! 

First, thank you so much for trying and buying our game. Virballs is a passion project for our studio, and we hope that you're having as much fun playing it as we have in making it. 

You might have already played through the first planet, Jambito, by now and are wondering, "What now?"

Good news! I'm here to tell you what comes next. 

[h1]The 2024 Roadmap[/h1]

[b]October 29, 2024 [/b]-  1st Patch. We're giving everyone an [b]Orb Pumpkin skin [/b]to celebrate Halloween. If you end up using it, send us a screenshot! We love seeing Orb out in the wild. (As a reminder, if you haven't downloaded your Early Access skin, that's free to all Early Access players and will disappear when we launch next year. Also, if you stream or make gameplay videos, let us know! We'll send you the exclusive Streamer skin.) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/6012c9c01ceb688b52a1f56f9fcf2002f3f82c1c.png[/img]

[b]November 4, 2024[/b]—Our first content update patch. This patch will include a new surprise feature. (We're keeping it secret for now, but we can't wait for you to play the mode!) This patch will also include any fixes for bugs that you've found. 

[b]November 12, 2024[/b] - Our first narrative update patch. Rita is getting a new voice. We'll also include any narrative changes we've made to the early levels and some new environment changes. 

[b]November 19, 2024[/b] - [b]Everfin World Release[/b] - You'll get all new levels to play on the Everfin planet. Think deep blue waters, sandy beaches, and killer waiterbots…. Orb really has his work cut out for him cleaning this planet up. Enjoy five new levels filled with new platform challenges and new bosses! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/c4904a04e6bd89b51dd0d2820557965832503ee0.png[/img]

[b]December 3, 2024[/b] - The Great Bug Roundup - We'll implement fixes for any bugs we find this week. 

[b]December 10, 2024[/b] - Our second narrative update patch. - We'll implement new story changes and any environment changes to match. (More details on this as we get closer) 

[b]December 17, 2024[/b] - [b]Dr. Corvid's Lab![/b] A new icon will appear on your world map, and Dr. Corvid's Lab will appear. The Lab is both a sandbox where you can practice your skills against any combo of virballs you can think of and an arena where we can drop survival challenges on you! Are you ready to win some new skins? Because we're ready to throw down some fun new challenges!
Starting next year, we'll ramp up for our full release, which will be sooner than you think! We'll keep you updated as we get closer. 

In the meantime, join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/gsqv6fS3wS]Discord [/url]for up-to-date news, community challenges, and fun. You never know when we'll pop up with contests to win cool prizes. 

Have fun, and beware the bees!
The Virball Team
